# MCP tool parameters

<!-- GENERATED by `cd backend && npm run gen:skills` from the tool schemas the MCP server registers. Do not edit by hand: `npm run gen:skills:check` fails CI when this page drifts. -->

Every tool the Nodaro MCP server offers and every parameter it takes, read from the server's own input schemas. What each tool is for, and how the tools fit together, is in the [MCP Tool Reference](tools.md).

This page shows Nodaro Cloud with every scope granted. A client sees only the tools its scopes allow (see [Scopes](tools.md#scopes)), and tools marked **Nodaro Cloud only** are not offered by self-hosted Community and Business installs.

A parameter written `a.b` is the field `b` of the object `a`, and `a[].b` is the field `b` of each item in the array `a`.

## `add_captions`

Needs `workflows:execute`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string |  | At least 1 character. |
| `captions` | object[] |  | ONE entry per WORD, `{ text, startMs, endMs }` in ms on the video's timeline — what `transcribe` returns. `startMs`/`endMs` are the word's SPOKEN window, not always its visibility window. |
| `captions[].text` | string | yes |  |
| `captions[].startMs` | number | yes | At least 0. |
| `captions[].endMs` | number | yes | At least 0. |
| `captions[].timestampMs` | number or null |  | At least 0. Default `null`. |
| `captions[].confidence` | number or null |  | From 0 to 1. Default `null`. |
| `auto_transcribe` | boolean |  |  |
| `transcribe_provider` | string |  | Auto-transcribe engine. `whisper` returns NO word timings: refused only when a KINETIC render's sole caption source is transcription; fine on `subtitle`. One of `whisper`, `incredibly-fast-whisper`, `elevenlabs-stt`. |
| `video_url` | string (URL) |  |  |
| `video_asset_id` | string |  |  |
| `style` | string |  | One of `subtitle`, `word-highlight`, `karaoke`, `tiktok-words`, `word-pop`, `bouncy`. |
| `position` | string |  | One of `bottom`, `top`, `center`. |
| `font_size` | integer |  | From 12 to 200. |
| `color` | string |  |  |
| `background_color` | string |  |  |
| `look` | string |  | Typography preset. UNSET = `outline` on kinetic styles (Montserrat 900, UPPERCASE, black outline, yellow spoken word), `clean` (Inter) on `subtitle`. One of `outline`, `clean`. |
| `font_family` | string |  | Type face. Rubik/Heebo/Cairo/Tajawal cover Hebrew and Arabic. One of `Inter`, `Roboto`, `Open Sans`, `Montserrat`, `Poppins`, `Raleway`, `Nunito`, `Lato`, `Playfair Display`, `Merriweather`, `Lora`, `EB Garamond`, `Bebas Neue`, `Oswald`, `Anton`, `Dancing Script`, `Pacifico`, `Caveat`, `Roboto Mono`, `Fira Code`, `Rubik`, `Heebo`, `Cairo`, `Tajawal`. |
| `font_weight` | integer |  | CSS weight 100-900, in 100s. From 100 to 900. |
| `stroke_color` | string |  | Outline colour. Needs stroke_width > 0. |
| `stroke_width` | number |  | Outline width in px; 0 removes it. From 0 to 40. |
| `highlight_color` | string |  | Kinetic only. Colour of the spoken/active word. |
| `uppercase` | boolean |  | Render captions in UPPERCASE. |
| `position_y` | number |  | The block's CENTRE as % of height; overrides `position`. ~65 sits below a face, above the app UI. From 0 to 100. |
| `animate` | boolean |  | Kinetic only. false freezes the per-word motion. Default true. |
| `max_words_per_line` | integer |  | Max WORDS per caption line (or tiktok-words page) for any input, on top of the width budget; on a static `text` block it sets the line breaks. 1-2 is the CapCut read; unset fits the width. Inert on word-pop. From 1 to 20. |
| `segments` | object[] |  | Different caption treatments on time ranges of the SAME video in one call. Each item: start_ms/end_ms, any style/look lever (omitted ones inherit the top level) and optionally its own `text`/`captions` (else the shared transcript filtered to the range). Ranges must NOT overlap; a segmented render is all Remotion, so any style takes any lever. At least 1 item. |
| `segments[].start_ms` | number | yes | At least 0. |
| `segments[].end_ms` | number | yes | At least 0. |
| `segments[].style` | string |  | One of `subtitle`, `word-highlight`, `karaoke`, `tiktok-words`, `word-pop`, `bouncy`. |
| `segments[].position` | string |  | One of `bottom`, `top`, `center`. |
| `segments[].font_size` | integer |  | From 12 to 200. |
| `segments[].color` | string |  |  |
| `segments[].background_color` | string |  |  |
| `segments[].look` | string |  | One of `outline`, `clean`. |
| `segments[].font_family` | string |  | One of `Inter`, `Roboto`, `Open Sans`, `Montserrat`, `Poppins`, `Raleway`, `Nunito`, `Lato`, `Playfair Display`, `Merriweather`, `Lora`, `EB Garamond`, `Bebas Neue`, `Oswald`, `Anton`, `Dancing Script`, `Pacifico`, `Caveat`, `Roboto Mono`, `Fira Code`, `Rubik`, `Heebo`, `Cairo`, `Tajawal`. |
| `segments[].font_weight` | integer |  | From 100 to 900. |
| `segments[].stroke_color` | string |  |  |
| `segments[].stroke_width` | number |  | From 0 to 40. |
| `segments[].highlight_color` | string |  |  |
| `segments[].uppercase` | boolean |  |  |
| `segments[].position_y` | number |  | From 0 to 100. |
| `segments[].animate` | boolean |  |  |
| `segments[].max_words_per_line` | integer |  | From 1 to 20. |
| `segments[].text` | string |  | At least 1 character. |
| `segments[].captions` | object[] |  |  |
| `segments[].captions[].text` | string | yes |  |
| `segments[].captions[].startMs` | number | yes | At least 0. |
| `segments[].captions[].endMs` | number | yes | At least 0. |
| `segments[].captions[].timestampMs` | number or null |  | At least 0. Default `null`. |
| `segments[].captions[].confidence` | number or null |  | From 0 to 1. Default `null`. |

## `analyze_prompt`

Needs `workflows:execute`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nodeType` | string | yes | Target node type, e.g. generate-image, image-to-video, generate-music. |
| `prompt` | string |  | The user's rough idea. Omit to build from scratch. At most 5000 characters. |
| `provider` | string |  |  |
| `style` | string |  |  |
| `aspectRatio` | string |  |  |
| `duration` | number |  |  |
| `llmModel` | string |  | LLM model id. Defaults to this feature's configured model. One of `gemini-3-flash`, `gemini-3.6-flash`, `gemini-3.7-flash`, `gemini-3.8-flash`, `claude-haiku-4.5`, `claude-sonnet-4.6`, `gpt-5.2`, `gemini-3.1-pro`, `claude-opus-4.7`, `gpt-5.4`, `gpt-5.5`, `gpt-5.6-luna`, `gpt-5.6-terra`, `gpt-5.6-sol`, `gpt-6-astra`, `gpt-6-luna`, `gpt-6-sol`, `gpt-6.1-sol`, `grok-4.6`, `grok-4.7`, `claude-sonnet-5`, `claude-sonnet-5.5`, `claude-opus-4.8`, `claude-opus-5`, `claude-opus-5.5`, `claude-fable-5`, `kimi-k3`, `deepseek-v4.1-flash`. |
| `reasoning_effort` | string |  | Reasoning effort (model-dependent; xhigh/max bill one tier up; on a Claude model any effort runs on Anthropic's own API and bills one rung up as well). One of `none`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max`. |
| `advanced_mode` | boolean |  | Gemini and Claude models. Runs on the provider's own API so temperature, max tokens and the full reasoning range apply. Bills one credit rung up (a premium model moves to premium-direct); any other model returns 400 advanced_mode_unsupported. On a Claude model any reasoning_effort already runs this way. |
| `temperature` | number |  | Sampling temperature. Only honoured when advanced_mode is true. From 0 to 2. |
| `max_tokens` | integer |  | Output token cap. Only honoured when advanced_mode is true. From 1 to 32768. |

## `animate_image`

Needs `workflows:execute`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string |  | At most 8000 characters. |
| `image_url` | string (URL) |  |  |
| `image_asset_id` | string |  |  |
| `model` | string |  | Video model. Default seedance-2-fast. Recommended: bytedance-lite, bytedance-pro, bytedance-pro-fast, gemini-omni-flash, gemini-omni-video, grok-i2v, grok-imagine-video-1.5, hailuo-2.3, hailuo-2.3-pro, hailuo-standard, happyhorse-i2v, happyhorse-ref2v, kling, kling-3-omni, kling-3.0, kling-master, kling-turbo, ltx-2.3-fast, ltx-2.3-pro, minimax, minimax-h3, runway-kie, seedance, seedance-2, seedance-2-5, seedance-2-fast, seedance-2-mini, veo3, veo3.1, veo3_lite, wan-2.7-i2v, wan-3, wan-3-prime, wan-i2v, wan-turbo. Unknown values silently fall back. Call list_models { kind: "video", mode: "i2v" } for capabilities + recommendations. |
| `duration` | number |  | Duration (seconds). Snaps to nearest supported. |
| `aspect_ratio` | string |  | Aspect ratio. Variations / unsupported fall back. |
| `resolution` | string |  | Output resolution. Provider-dependent — common values: 480p, 720p, 1080p, 4k. Unknown values fall back to the model's default. |
| `sound` | boolean |  |  |
| `end_frame_url` | string (URL) |  |  |
| `end_frame_asset_id` | string |  | Nodaro job id or upload asset id whose image is used as the END frame. Use this instead of end_frame_url when you have a Nodaro asset — never construct /jobs/.../output URLs manually, those don't exist. |
| `reference_image_urls` | string[] or string |  | Identity/reference images (URLs or Nodaro asset IDs), capped at the model's own limit: seedance-2-5 30, seedance-2 family + minimax-h3 9, wan-3 / wan-3-prime 10, gemini-omni-video / gemini-omni-flash / kling-3-omni / grok-i2v 7, happyhorse-ref2v 9, veo3/veo3.1 3. Resolved server-side; silently dropped on models with no reference path. Accepts an array; a lone URL or JSON-stringified array is coerced. |
| `reference_video_urls` | string[] or string |  | Reference videos for style/motion transfer (URLs or Nodaro asset IDs). seedance-2-5 up to 10, seedance-2 family + minimax-h3 up to 3, wan-3 / wan-3-prime up to 5 (each clip 1-15s, ≤15s combined; input seconds + output duration ≤30s), gemini-omni-video / gemini-omni-flash 1; dropped on models without video-reference support. Ignored in 'frames' mode. Accepts an array; a lone URL or JSON-stringified array is coerced. |
| `reference_audio_urls` | string[] or string |  | Reference audio for soundtrack-driven motion (URLs or Nodaro asset IDs). seedance-2-5 up to 10, seedance-2 family + minimax-h3 up to 3, wan-3 / wan-3-prime up to 5 (each clip 1-15s, ≤15s combined); dropped on models without audio-reference support. Ignored in 'frames' mode. Accepts an array; a lone URL or JSON-stringified array is coerced. |
| `loop_trim` | object |  | Smart-loop-cut post-process. When enabled, trims the output to its cleanest loop boundary. quality=lossless for byte-perfect stream-copy at keyframes, precise for frame-precise re-encode. |
| `loop_trim.enabled` | boolean | yes |  |
| `loop_trim.frames_to_test` | integer |  | From 1 to 64. |
| `loop_trim.quality` | string |  | One of `lossless`, `precise`. |
| `auto_loop_trim` | boolean |  | DEPRECATED: use loop_trim instead. Maps to loop_trim={enabled,frames_to_test:8,quality:'precise'}. |
| `connected_references` | object[] |  | Advanced structured references — the editor's wired-reference shape (each needs at least {id, defaultName, source, url}, url a public https URL). Assembled server-side into per-ref @image_N directives + {image:N} token resolution (labeled/ordered refs, unlike flat reference_image_urls). Only models with image-reference support attach them. At most 14 items. |
| `connected_references[].id` | string | yes |  |
| `connected_references[].defaultName` | string | yes |  |
| `connected_references[].source` | string | yes | One of `manual`, `wired-image`, `wired-character`, `wired-face`, `wired-object`, `wired-creature`, `wired-location`. |
| `connected_references[].description` | string |  |  |
| `connected_references[].url` | string (URL) | yes |  |
| `connected_references[].characterSlug` | string |  |  |
| `connected_references[].variantSlug` | string |  |  |
| `connected_references[].bucket` | string |  |  |
| `connected_references[].characterCanonicalDescription` | string or null |  |  |
| `connected_references[].elementInjection` | string or null |  |  |
| `connected_references[].locationCanonicalDescription` | string or null |  |  |
| `connected_references[].locationSlug` | string |  |  |
| `connected_references[].locationVariantBucket` | string |  |  |
| `connected_references[].locationVariantSlug` | string |  |  |
| `connected_references[].locationVariantDisplayName` | string |  |  |
| `connected_references[].locationReferencePhotoKind` | string |  | One of `wide`, `interior`, `exterior`, `detail`, `moodBoard`, `other`. |
| `connected_references[].variantDescription` | string or null |  |  |
| `connected_references[].variantDisplayName` | string |  |  |
| `connected_references[].defaultUsageMode` | string |  | One of `identical`, `face`, `face-pose`, `pose`, `emotion`, `style`, `name`, `none`. |
| `connected_references[].defaultRole` | string |  |  |
| `connected_references[].isExtraRef` | boolean |  |  |
| `connected_references[].loraReplicateVersion` | string or null |  |  |
| `connected_references[].loraTriggerWord` | string or null |  |  |
| `connected_references[].loraTrainingStatus` | string or null |  |  |
| `connected_references[].identityLock` | object |  |  |
| `connected_references[].identityLock.enabled` | boolean | yes |  |
| `connected_references[].identityLock.text` | string |  |  |
| `connected_references[].descriptionOverride` | string |  | At most 2000 characters. |
| `described_references` | object[] |  | References you can NAME and DESCRIBE but have no image for — an un-bound cast role, a character that exists only in the script. No url, so nothing is attached and no @image_N seat is used: each becomes a `<Name> — <description>.` line, so a name in your prompt reaches the model as a real, described subject. At most 10 items. |
| `described_references[].name` | string | yes | At most 80 characters. |
| `described_references[].description` | string | yes | At most 2000 characters. |
| `reference_order` | string[] |  | Advanced: reorder connected_references by their stable ids; renumbers the @image_N bindings. At most 14 items. |

## `apply_edl`

Needs `workflows:execute`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `edl` | object (map of any) or string | yes | The edit-decision list, as an object OR a JSON string — from plan_edit, or hand-authored to the @nodaro/shared Edl contract. |
| `sources` | string (URL)[] |  | Positional media-URL overrides for the EDL's sources[], in sources order. |
| `transcript` | object (map of any) |  | Optional upstream transcript object, remapped through the cut for the result's transcript output. |
| `output` | string |  | Render a video (default) or an audio-only cut. One of `video`, `audio`. |
| `quality` | string |  | proxy (a fast 720p preview, at its own lower per-minute rate) or final (default). One of `proxy`, `final`. |
| `crossfade_ms` | number |  | Default crossfade on boundaries with no explicit transition, in ms. 0 = hard cuts (default). From 0 to 5000. |
| `clip_key` | string |  | clips-mode plan_edit clip this render cuts, "&lt;first inMs>-&lt;last outMs>" of the plan's clip; returned as clipKey on the result. |

## `approve_creature_main_image`

Needs `assets:write`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `creature_id` | string | yes | The creature id (uuid). |
| `candidate_job_id` | string | yes | The job id from a completed `generate_creature` call. The job must be status=completed, have `output_data.imageUrl` set, belong to the caller, AND its `input_data.attachToCreatureId` MUST match `creature_id` (cross-link IDOR gate). |
| `expected_updated_at` | string |  | Optimistic-concurrency token (the `updatedAt` from the studio snapshot). When provided and stale, the call returns a `concurrent_modification` error with the fresh `updatedAt` so the caller can re-fetch + retry. |

## `browse_gallery`

Needs `assets:read`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `scope` | string |  | `mine` (default) = the user's own library. `public` = recent public outputs from OTHER users (excludes the caller, mirrors the web app's public gallery). One of `mine`, `public`. |
| `limit` | integer |  | Max items to return (default 50, max 200). From 1 to 200. |
| `cursor` | string |  | ISO `completed_at` timestamp from a prior result's next_cursor |
| `kinds` | string[] |  | Media kinds to include. Default `["image", "video"]`. Pass any combination — `["audio"]` for music / TTS only, `["image", "video", "audio"]` for everything. At least 1 item. |
| `kind` | string |  | One of `image`, `video`, `audio`. |
| `query` | string |  | Optional prompt search — case-insensitive substring match against each item's prompt text. Use when the user asks for a topic ("show me all the rabbit images", "find my moonlit scenes"). Pass just the keyword (e.g. "rabbit"). At most 200 characters. |

## `combine_videos`

Needs `workflows:execute`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `videos` | object[] | yes | At least 2 video sources. At least 2 items. |
| `videos[].url` | string (URL) |  |  |
| `videos[].asset_id` | string |  |  |
| `transition` | string |  | One of `cut`, `fade`, `dissolve`, `dip-to-black`, `dip-to-white`, `fadegrays`, `wipe-left`, `wipe-right`, `wipe-up`, `wipe-down`, `wipe-tl`, `wipe-tr`, `wipe-bl`, `wipe-br`, `slide-left`, `slide-right`, `slide-up`, `slide-down`, `smooth-left`, `smooth-right`, `smooth-up`, `smooth-down`, `circle-open`, `circle-close`, `circle-crop`, `rect-crop`, `horz-open`, `horz-close`, `vert-open`, `vert-close`, `diag-tl`, `diag-tr`, `diag-bl`, `diag-br`, `hl-slice`, `hr-slice`, `vu-slice`, `vd-slice`, `reveal-left`, `reveal-right`, `reveal-up`, `reveal-down`, `cover-left`, `cover-right`, `cover-up`, `cover-down`, `pixelize`, `radial`, `hblur`, `distance`, `zoom-in`, `squeeze-h`, `squeeze-v`. |
| `transition_duration` | number |  | From 0 to 5. |
| `audio_mode` | string |  | One of `keep`, `crossfade`, `remove`. |
| `audio_crossfade_curve` | string |  | Curve shape for audio crossfade (only consulted when audio_mode='crossfade'). One of `linear`, `equal-power`, `smooth`, `logarithmic`, `exponential`. |
| `audio_crossfade_duration` | number |  | Audio-only crossfade length in seconds — blends the soundtracks without altering the video stream (at cuts the video is stream-copied untouched). Omitted: follows transition_duration. From 0 to 5. |
| `smart_cut` | boolean |  | PSNR-match the last frames of each clip against the first frames of the next and cut where the chosen smart_cut_mode decides — seamless for continuation clips (next generated from prev's last frame). Replaces the fixed trim_* frame counts. nodaro.ai only (self-hosted editions return cloud_only_feature). |
| `smart_cut_mode` | string |  | Smart-cut cut-point algorithm. Default 'best-pair'. The preroll variants differ in which side of an overlap survives: 'preroll-keep-next' favors the incoming clip, 'preroll-keep-prev' the outgoing one. Same search windows and fixed-trims fallback in every mode. One of `best-pair`, `preroll-keep-prev`, `preroll-keep-next`. |
| `smart_cut_frames_prev` | integer |  | Smart-cut search window at each clip's END (frames, default 8). From 1 to 24. |
| `smart_cut_frames_next` | integer |  | Smart-cut search window at each clip's START (frames, default 8). From 1 to 24. |
| `trim_start_frames` | integer |  | Frames trimmed from the START of each non-first clip (default 1). Pin it for frame-exact cuts; also the smart-cut fallback. From 0 to 120. |
| `trim_end_frames` | integer |  | Frames trimmed from the END of each non-final clip (default 2). Pin it for frame-exact cuts; also the smart-cut fallback. From 0 to 120. |

One of: expressions, poses, lighting, angles, headAngles, bodyAngles, custom. `angles` is the legacy alias for `headAngles` (head-and-shoulders); prefer `headAngles` for new code. For animated clips, use `generate_character_motion` instead. One of `expressions`, `poses`, `lighting`, `angles`, `headAngles`, `bodyAngles`, `custom`. |

Variant name — e.g. expressions: 'smile'/'angry'/...; headAngles/bodyAngles: 'front'/'3/4 left'/'left profile'/'right profile'/'3/4 right'/'back'; poses: 'standing'/'walking'/...; lighting: 'daylight'/'night'/'dramatic'; or any short label for custom. From 1 to 100 characters. |

One of: expressions, poses, angles, body_angles, lighting_variations. One of `expressions`, `poses`, `angles`, `body_angles`, `lighting_variations`, `sheets`, `detail_closeups`, `outfit_variations`, `boards`. |

| `style` | string |  | At most 50 characters. |

Use to iterate on an existing motion clip with a new prompt (e.g. 'same shot but faster rotation'). Routes through providers with video-to-video capability. |

DO NOT invent UUIDs. At least 1 character. |

| `style` | string |  | At most 50 characters. |
| `canonical_description` | string |  | Canonical object description (preferred prompt context; falls back to category + name). At most 4000 characters. |
| `attach_to_object_id` | string |  | When set, append the result to this object's motion_clips[] bucket. Ownership is re-verified BEFORE credit reservation, so a forged id is rejected with `not_found` and no credits are charged. |
| `attach_name` | string |  | Display name for the motion-clip entry (defaults to motion description). From 1 to 200 characters. |
| `aspect_ratio` | string |  | Output aspect ratio. Defaults to 1:1 (product-showcase framing) — objects favor square framing vs. location's 16:9 cinematic default. One of `1:1`, `3:4`, `16:9`, `9:16`, `4:3`. |
| `refine_from_video_url` | string (URL) |  | Refinement path: when set, route to video-to-video using THIS clip as the source instead of running image-to-video from `source_image_url`. Use to iterate on an existing motion clip with a new prompt (e.g. 'same shot but faster rotation'). Routes through providers with video-to-video capability. |

## `generate_speech`

Needs `workflows:execute`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | yes | From 1 to 10000 characters. |
| `presetId` | string |  | Apply a built-in/custom preset by id from list_node_presets; the preset tunes delivery (speed/stability/style). Explicit fields below override it. A preset's promptPrefix/promptSuffix wrap your text. From 1 to 200 characters. |
| `voice_id` | string |  | Voice — pass a premade voice NAME (recommended) or an ElevenLabs UUID (only for custom voices the user has explicitly cloned). DO NOT invent UUIDs — passing an unknown UUID fails with 'voice_not_found'. Premade names: Rachel, Aria, Roger, Sarah, Laura, Charlie, George, Callum, River, Liam, Charlotte, Alice, Matilda, Will, Jessica, Eric, Chris, Brian, Daniel, Lily, Bill. If unsure pick by character: female warm = Rachel; female young = Aria / Lily; male deep = Roger / Brian; male neutral = George / Daniel; British = Charlie / Charlotte. Defaults to Rachel. |
| `model` | string |  | TTS model. `elevenlabs-v4` (default) supports `[audio tags]` like `[laughs]`, `[whispers]`, `[sighs]` for emotion, and is fully multilingual — use it for ALL languages including Hebrew/Arabic/CJK (stability + similarity only, no speed/style). `elevenlabs-v3` is the previous model (same tags; stability only). `elevenlabs-v4-turbo` is the fast v4 (same tags and levers; Turbo's price). `elevenlabs-turbo` is cheaper for plain narration. `elevenlabs-multilingual` is a legacy v2 model via a third-party wrapper known to garble some languages (Hebrew observed) — only use it for a v2-only-verified voice (`text` is capped per model: 10,000 chars on v4, 5,000 on v3 — split longer scripts). `elevenlabs` is the legacy id of `elevenlabs-turbo`. Call list_models { kind: "audio", mode: "tts" } for the full sheet. One of `elevenlabs-v3`, `elevenlabs-v4`, `elevenlabs-v4-turbo`, `elevenlabs-turbo`, `elevenlabs-multilingual`, `elevenlabs`. |
| `voice_type` | string |  | One of `premade`, `custom`, `library`. |
| `stability` | number |  | From 0 to 1. |
| `similarity_boost` | number |  | From 0 to 1. |
| `style` | number |  | From 0 to 1. |
| `speed` | number |  | From 0.7 to 1.2. |
| `language_code` | string |  |  |
| `previous_text` | string |  | The line spoken just BEFORE this one in the finished piece (the previous clip's text) — context for continuous intonation across clips; up to 1,000 characters, the end of a longer passage. Used by models that stitch; others ignore it. Not spoken. At most 1000 characters. |
| `next_text` | string |  | The line spoken just AFTER this one (the next clip's text) — the start of a longer passage; up to 1,000 characters. Same continuity rule as previous_text. At most 1000 characters. |

## `generate_studio_clip`

| `expected_input_hash` | string |  | The reviewed linked-clip quote hash; required for a retake submission. |
| `retake_result_key` | string |  | Native or copied linked take to retake exactly. Omit mode/overrides. Quote with dry_run; submit with expected_input_hash and client_request_id. At least 1 character. |
| `overrides` | object (map of any) |  | Per-call overrides of the scene's own settings. See the operating skill. |
| `dry_run` | boolean |  | Price it and stop — no job is started and nothing is charged. |
| `client_request_id` | string |  | Optional retry token (8–128 chars of letters, digits, `_ - . :`). If a call times out or the connection drops, reuse the same value when retrying so the run is not started or charged twice; use a fresh value for a genuinely new run. From 8 to 128 characters. |

Wan 3.0 takes each clip at 1-15s and ≤15s combined. Dropped on models without audio-reference support. |
| `character_references` | object[] |  | Keeps a person's face (gemini-omni-video / gemini-omni-flash only); see docs/nodes/ai-video/generate-video.md. At most 3 items. |

| `character_references[].description` | string | yes |  |
| `character_references[].name` | string |  |  |
| `character_references[].voice_preset` | string |  | Gemini voice id (e.g. kore): pins this character's voice. |

| `layout` | string |  | Arrangement algorithm. Default 'smart' (justified rows; output height floats to avoid cropping). One of `smart`, `grid`. |
| `resolution` | string |  | Output long-edge resolution. Default '4K' (3840px). One of `2K`, `4K`. |
| `aspect_ratio` | string |  | Output canvas ratio as W:H, e.g. '1:1','4:3','3:2','16:9','21:9','4:5','3:4','2:3','9:16'. Exact in 'grid'; a target that steers row count in 'smart'. Default '4:3'. |
| `gap` | integer |  | Gap between images + outer margin, in px. Default 24. From 0 to 200. |
| `background_color` | string |  | Background shown in the gaps, #RRGGBB. Default #ffffff. |
| `numbered` | boolean |  | Stamp 1-based sequence numbers at each image's corner in `images` order — storyboard mode. |
| `badge_position` | string |  | Which corner the number/label badges sit in. Default 'top-left' (storyboard convention); 'top-right' keeps them clear of a subject composed left-of-centre. One of `top-left`, `top-right`. |

## `lip_sync`

Needs `workflows:execute`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `image_url` | string (URL) |  | Portrait/face image. Use this for kling-avatar(-pro) and infinitalk. |
| `image_asset_id` | string |  |  |
| `video_url` | string (URL) |  | Face video (for video-input providers like latentsync / video-retalking). Most users want image_url. |
| `video_asset_id` | string |  |  |
| `audio_url` | string (URL) |  |  |
| `audio_asset_id` | string |  |  |
| `audio_duration_sec` | number |  | Length of the audio in seconds. Models billed by the second reserve and charge by this length; when it is left out, the audio is measured first. From 0.1 to 600. |
| `prompt` | string |  | Optional performance hint (e.g. 'a confident TED speaker'). Some models use it; others ignore. At most 500 characters. |
| `model` | string |  | Lip-sync model. Default kling-avatar. Options (list price where the model has one fixed price; per-second models show their 15 s bucket; duration-tiered models say so): kling-avatar (300 cr/15s), kling-avatar-pro (600 cr/15s), infinitalk (420 cr), omnihuman-1-5 (1020 cr/15s), latentsync (7 cr), wav2lip (10 cr), video-retalking (200 cr), sadtalker (50 cr), heygen-lipsync-precision (510 cr/15s), lipsync-2-pro (630 cr/15s), sync-lipsync-v3 (1000 cr/15s), volcengine-lipsync (300 cr/15s), seedance-2 (duration-tiered), seedance-2-fast (duration-tiered), seedance-2-mini (duration-tiered), seedance-2-5 (duration-tiered), minimax-h3 (550 cr). Input type (image vs video) and which model fits singing, dubbing, cinematic or the cheapest draft: get_node_skill("lip-sync"). Unknown values fall back to kling-avatar. |
| `resolution` | string |  | Resolution lever. infinitalk: 480p\|720p. seedance-2(-fast): 480p\|720p\|1080p. omnihuman-1-5: 720p\|1080p (default 1080p). Other models ignore this. One of `480p`, `720p`, `1080p`. |
| `seed` | integer |  | Reproducibility seed (omnihuman-1-5). Same seed + inputs → near-identical result. From 0 to 2147483647. |
| `fast_mode` | boolean |  | omnihuman-1-5 only — trade some quality for faster generation. |
| `mode` | string |  | volcengine-lipsync only. 'lite' (default) = single-person frontal, faster. 'basic' = complex scenes; pair with open_scenedet for multi-speaker. Other models ignore this. One of `lite`, `basic`. |
| `separate_vocal` | boolean |  | volcengine-lipsync only. Strip background noise from the driving audio. |
| `open_scenedet` | boolean |  | volcengine-lipsync 'basic' mode only. Scene detection + speaker ID — enables multi-speaker dubbing. |
| `align_audio` | boolean |  | volcengine-lipsync 'lite' mode only. Loop the source video when the audio is longer (default on). |
| `align_audio_reverse` | boolean |  | volcengine-lipsync 'lite' mode only. Ping-pong the loop (requires align_audio on). |
| `templ_start_seconds` | number |  | volcengine-lipsync only. Start time (seconds) in the source video to drive from (advanced). |

## `update_workflow_json`

Needs `workflows:write`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `workflow_id` | string | yes |  |
| `nodes` | object (map of any)[] |  |  |
| `edges` | object (map of any)[] |  |  |
| `settings` | object (map of any) |  |  |
| `thumbnail_url` | string (URL) or null |  | Public URL of the workflow's thumbnail/preview image, or null to clear it. Must be an already-hosted image URL. |
| `expected_updated_at` | string |  | Optimistic concurrency — the updated_at from get_workflow_json. If provided and the DB updated_at doesn't match, returns a conflict error. |
| `expected_version` | integer |  | Integer CAS — the version from get_workflow_json. Preferred over expected_updated_at (monotonic counter bumped by the DB on every content change). At least 1. |
| `delta` | object |  | Id-keyed partial update applied atomically against base_version (from get_workflow_json): upsert or delete whole nodes and edges by id, optionally set name/settings. Mutually exclusive with nodes/edges/settings/thumbnail_url/expected_*. Prefer this over re-sending the whole graph — a stale full-body write clobbers concurrent edits. |
| `delta.base_version` | integer | yes | The version from get_workflow_json this delta was computed against; the write is refused (conflict) if the workflow moved on. At least 1. |
| `delta.upsert_nodes` | object (map of any)[] |  | Whole nodes to add or replace, matched by id. |
| `delta.delete_node_ids` | string[] |  | Node ids to remove (their edges are removed by the server). |
| `delta.upsert_edges` | object (map of any)[] |  | Whole edges to add or replace, matched by id. |
| `delta.delete_edge_ids` | string[] |  | Edge ids to remove. |
| `delta.set` | object |  |  |

## `video_analysis`

Needs `workflows:execute`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `video_asset_id` | string |  | Nodaro video job id or uploaded-asset id. |
| `video_url` | string (URL) |  | Direct URL of a video file. |
| `youtube_url` | string |  | YouTube video URL (youtube.com / youtu.be). Max 10 minutes; no live streams. |
| `variations` | boolean |  | Cast-variations opt-in: the analysis also detects per-entity appearance LOOKS — a plain wardrobe change between scenes counts exactly as much as a dream / flashback / disguise / era look — and binds each look to its scenes (`slots[].variations` + `scenes[].slotVariations`). Default false: the result keeps the pre-variations shape. |
| `music_video` | boolean |  | Declare the clip a MUSIC VIDEO: the song IS the piece, so ALL sung lyrics are transcribed verbatim as per-scene `speech` layers (the instrumental bed stays its own `music` layer). Default false: soundtrack vocals nobody on screen performs are folded into the `music` layer's description, and `speech` carries only words uttered inside the story world. |
| `translate_speech_to_english` | boolean |  | Translate spoken and sung words to English. Default false: speech is quoted verbatim in the language actually spoken. Independent of `translate_on_screen_text_to_english` — set this alone for English narration over footage whose signage stays in its original script. |
| `translate_on_screen_text_to_english` | boolean |  | Translate on-screen text (signs, captions, titles) to English. Default false: transcribed verbatim in its original script. Note this text lives in `visual`, the generation prompt — so translating it means a regenerated shot renders the English wording. Brand, product, person, and place names keep their original form under both flags, and the result's `language` always reports the language actually spoken in the footage. |
| `analysis_focus` | string |  | Optional steer for the analysis (e.g. 'focus on the product shots and on-screen text'). At most 2000 characters. |

## `voice_changer_pro`

Needs `workflows:execute` · Nodaro Cloud only.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `audio_url` | string (URL) |  |  |
| `audio_asset_id` | string |  |  |
| `video_url` | string (URL) |  | Recast voices in a talking video — demux audio, run multi-speaker recast, remux. |
| `video_asset_id` | string |  | A Nodaro video job id to recast (alternative to video_url). |
| `ordered_voices` | (string or object or null)[] | yes | Ordered list of target voices — speaker 1 → voices[0], speaker 2 → voices[1], etc. Each entry is either a bare voice id (premade name or ElevenLabs UUID), an object { voiceId, engine, stability, similarityBoost, style, useSpeakerBoost, seed, volumeMode, volume } with per-voice settings, or null — a keep-slot that keeps that speaker's original voice while later speakers are still recast. At least one entry must be non-null. `engine`: "sts" (default, speech-to-speech recast), "v3" or "v4" (Re-speak — the performance is regenerated from the transcript; v3 takes stability 0/0.5/1 only, v4 any 0–1 plus similarityBoost). `seed` (0–4294967295) makes that speaker's recast reproducible. From 1 to 8 items. |
| `ordered_voices[].voiceId` | string | yes | At least 1 character. |
| `ordered_voices[].engine` | string |  | One of `sts`, `v3`, `v4`. |
| `ordered_voices[].stability` | number |  | From 0 to 1. |
| `ordered_voices[].similarityBoost` | number |  | From 0 to 1. |
| `ordered_voices[].style` | number |  | From 0 to 1. |
| `ordered_voices[].useSpeakerBoost` | boolean |  |  |
| `ordered_voices[].seed` | integer |  | From 0 to 4294967295. |
| `ordered_voices[].volumeMode` | string |  | One of `match`, `normalize`, `manual`. |
| `ordered_voices[].volume` | number |  | From 0 to 200. |
| `voice_fx` | object |  | Reverb/echo applied to the combined recast voices before background is mixed back. preset = reverb space (room/hall/church/…), telephone, megaphone, echo, or custom; wetDryMix (0–100) for reverb wetness; delayMs (20–2000) + decay (0–1) for echo. |
| `voice_fx.preset` | string | yes | One of `room`, `bathroom`, `car`, `hall`, `concert-hall`, `church`, `cave`, `arena`, `outdoor`, `telephone`, `megaphone`, `echo`, `custom`. |
| `voice_fx.wetDryMix` | number |  | From 0 to 100. |
| `voice_fx.delayMs` | number |  | From 20 to 2000. |
| `voice_fx.decay` | number |  | From 0 to 1. |
| `analysis` | object |  | A pre-computed analysis from a prior voice_changer_pro analyze run (its job output_data): the recast then works from the EXACT speaker list you mapped ordered_voices against, instead of re-detecting (which can produce a different list). Each speaker's segments[].text carries the transcript — required input for a speaker with engine "v3" or "v4". This param existed in the wire contract before it existed here (the tool description referenced it — now it is real). |
| `analysis.vocalsUrl` | string (URL) | yes |  |
| `analysis.backgroundUrl` | string (URL) |  |  |
| `analysis.speakers` | object[] | yes | From 1 to 64 items. |
| `analysis.speakers[].id` | string | yes | At least 1 character. |
| `analysis.speakers[].segments` | object[] | yes | At least 1 item. |
| `analysis.languageCode` | string |  | At most 16 characters. |
| `analysis.languageProbability` | number |  | From 0 to 1. |
| `model` | string |  | Voice model override. |
| `preserve_background` | boolean |  | Mix the separated music/SFX bed back under the new voices (default: true). The voice is always split out first regardless; false yields a clean voice-only result. |
| `separation_quality` | string |  | Quality of the voice/music separation: 'fast' (default, quicker, preserves more of the voice) or 'best' (finer voice/music separation). One of `fast`, `best`. |
| `music_volume_mode` | string |  | Background music level: match (original), normalize (loudnorm), or manual. One of `match`, `normalize`, `manual`. |
| `music_volume` | number |  | Background music volume % when music_volume_mode is manual. From 0 to 200. |
| `remove_background_noise` | boolean |  | Remove background noise before recasting — yields a clean voice-only result. |
| `output` | string |  | Output mode. 'video' (default) returns a finished merged video. 'stems' returns the dry per-track stems instead (for interactive mixing) — then render with voice_changer_pro_export. One of `video`, `stems`. |
